note: Fixtures under files/ are sample documents to be corrected. The ES samples are in Spanish on purpose (they exercise Spanish-only rules such as anglicism italics, the tu-form and the Metabase object-name split). The EN sample exercises the English-language rules and the per-language italics recalibration. All fixtures use Stratio Discovery scenarios (Metabase, collections, questions, dashboards, drivers, JDBC, Stratio Command Center deployment options). Prompts and assertions are in English.

evals.prompt: Review the file .claude/skills/write-stratio-docs/evals/files/test-naming-italics.adoc (a Spanish-language sample page) and return the corrected text. Report the corrections you would make, without editing the file.
evals.expected_output: The file corrected with: product names in italics and full form, Gosec not GoSec, the {modulename} attribute preferred over a hardcoded Virtualizer, PostgreSQL with its trademark symbol, generic jargon in italics, first person plural and 'Por favor' removed, em-dash aside turned into parentheses, temporal formula fixed, the anaphoric 'Dicha' replaced, ASCII arrow turned into U+2192, source language corrected and the link text made descriptive. The example URL inside the code block stays as it is: the backslash escape applies to example URLs in prose, not inside a listing.
assertions: The bare product name 'Discovery' has been corrected to '_Stratio Discovery_' (italics + full name) everywhere, including the page title
'Stratio GoSec' and the bare 'GoSec' have been corrected to '_Stratio Gosec_' (Gosec, not GoSec)
'Stratio Virtualizer' and the bare 'Crossdata' have been written as '_Stratio {modulename}_' (the Antora attribute is preferred over a hardcoded name)
The third party 'PostgreSQL' carries the registered trademark symbol: 'PostgreSQL®'
'_Metabase®_' has been corrected to plain 'Metabase': it is a third party, so it takes neither italics nor a trademark symbol
The first person plural has been removed: 'vamos a explicar' and 'Recomendamos' have become impersonal forms such as 'se explica' / 'se recomienda'
'Por favor' has been removed from the sentence that carried it
The generic anglicisms 'driver', 'pool', 'endpoint' and 'logs' appear in italics in this Spanish document: '_driver_', '_pool_', '_endpoint_', '_logs_'
The em-dash aside '—si el operador tiene permisos—' has been turned into parentheses: '(si el operador tiene permisos)'
The temporal formula 'En el momento del despliegue' has been replaced with 'Durante el despliegue', and 'con posterioridad' with 'tras él'
The anaphoric 'Dicha configuración' has been replaced with 'Esta configuración' or an equivalent
The ASCII arrow in "'Admin settings' -> 'Databases'" has been replaced with the Unicode arrow '→'
'pulsa el botón "Add database"' has been rewritten as 'haz clic en "Add database"'
The environment variable 'VIRTUALIZER_JDBC_FROM_EXTRA_JARS' and the value 'false' appear in backticks
The block '[source,ruby]' has been corrected to '[source,bash]'
The example URL 'https://mi-instancia.example.com' inside the command is left as is inside the code block (no escaping is needed there)
The link text 'aquí' has been replaced with a descriptive text naming the destination
The Spanish link to English-only documentation carries the '^[English]^' marker

The option `VIRTUALIZER_JDBC_FROM_EXTRA_JARS` is reported or rewritten as its descriptor title, "Use virtualizer jdbc from Extra JARs", in double quotes, with the variable in backticks in parentheses (R28)

The JDBC driver version '3.1.1' is reported as wrong for release 0.56.4-0.2.0: CHANGELOG.md states 4.0.1
The date '(julio 2026)' is reported as incomplete and badly formatted: it must be '(22 de julio de 2026)', matching CHANGELOG.md
The date '18 de septiembre de 2023' is reported as disagreeing with CHANGELOG.md, which dates 0.43.4-0.2.0 on 2023-07-21
The bare 'Stratio Discovery', 'Stratio Virtualizer' and 'Stratio Command Center' are reported as needing italics and, for Virtualizer, the '_Stratio {modulename}_' attribute
'Soporte para placements' is reported as an anglicism to be replaced with 'Compatibilidad con'
The generic terms 'driver', 'placements', 'priority classes' and 'snippets' are reported as needing italics in this Spanish page

evals.prompt: Review the file .claude/skills/write-stratio-docs/evals/files/test-upgrade-claims.adoc (a Spanish-language upgrade page). Verify every factual claim against the code of this repository and against the Stratio Discovery descriptor of Universe 15.1 in the Stratio/kubernetes-universe repository. Report only, do not modify the file.
evals.expected_output: A report identifying four false claims (the removed authenticator option, the absence of downtime, high availability, and the rollback without restoring a backup), the incomplete version, and the broken cross-reference anchor.
assertions: The version '0.56.4' is reported as incomplete: the version of _Stratio Discovery_ has two halves and must be written in full (for example 0.56.4-0.2.0), because a bare 0.56.4 reads as the Metabase version

The claim that the "Authentication method" deployment option was removed is reported as FALSE: the Universe 15.1 descriptor still declares it with its four values; what changed is that it moved from level 1 to level 2, the advanced view. The image only special-cases `gosec-sso` (with any other value it does not copy the JWT public key, does not set `JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_LOCATION` and drops the `uid` default of `JWT_USERNAME_CLAIM`), but `headers`, `jwt` and `metabase-native` remain supported and documented in `end-user-authentication.adoc`
The claim that the upgrade does not require downtime is reported as FALSE: the descriptor declares highAvailability false with a single replica
The claim that _Stratio Discovery_ supports high availability with several replicas is reported as FALSE
The claim that reverting the version is enough to go back is reported as FALSE or incomplete once the schema migration has been applied: the metadata database dump has to be restored
The duration 'unos 5 minutos' is reported as an unqualified figure: it must state whether it is measured or estimated
The cross-reference anchor '#_configuraciones_especificas' is reported as broken: deployment.adoc has no such section (the real id is '#_configuración')

The environment variable `AUTHENTICATOR` is reported as needing to be named by its descriptor title, "Authentication method", in double quotes, with the variable in backticks only if the reader needs it outside _Stratio Command Center_ (R28)
